runtimeScope: Only paired-evidence/d0 JSON/PNG; no main runtime rows/observations/visual decisions reused.
epochPolicy: Actual delivered activation and model-update boundaries; exact fixture index and event revision/buffer. Focused pixels anchor only. Full-state pixels can credit actual scroll/reveal frames within same no-delivery/no-replacement epoch.
unsupportedPolicy: No missing schema alone penalty. Partial captures receive member-specific evidence credit; uncovered/unmeasured aspects remain U rather than assumed product failure.
androidPixelCoordinates: Reconstruct mapping from actual PNG extent and raw logical dp viewport; supplied image_bounds_px is not assumed accurate. Native touch_bounds_dp remains separate physical instrumentation.
appleOffsets: Relative displacement of the same actual native heading leaf. No fabricated native content_frame, absolute card origin or physical-hit geometry.
